ex.en: He went out in spite of the rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著雨，他還是出去了。

ex.en: I went out in spite of the rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著雨，我還是出了門。

ex.en: He came in spite of the heavy snow.
ex.zh: 雖然下著大雪，但他還是來了。

spite.en: used to show that something happens even though something else might stop it

ex.en: He broke the window out of spite.
ex.zh: 他是出於惡意才打破窗戶的。

ex.en: She said it just out of spite.
ex.zh: 她那樣說純粹是出於怨恨。

spite.en: a wish to hurt or upset someone

ex.en: A company spokesperson declined to comment.
ex.zh: 公司發言人拒絕發表評論。

ex.en: The spokesperson said the product would launch in May.
ex.zh: 發言人表示產品將在五月上市。

spokesperson.en: a person who speaks officially for a group or company

ex.en: Let’s order the lobster! I’ve heard that’s the specialty dish here.
ex.zh: 我們點龍蝦吧！聽說那是這裡的招牌菜。

ex.en: What is the specialty food here?
ex.zh: 這裡的招牌菜是什麼？

specialty.en: a food or product that a place is especially known for

ex.en: Fashion is not my specialty.
ex.zh: 時尚不是我的專長。

ex.en: Her specialty is international tax law.
ex.zh: 她的專長是國際稅法。

specialty.en: a subject or skill that you know a lot about

ex.en: This is a specialty store for outdoor gear.
ex.zh: 這是一家戶外用品專賣店。

ex.en: The café serves specialty coffee.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡廳供應精品咖啡。

specialty.en: selling or dealing with one particular type of thing

ex.en: This email went straight into my spam folder.
ex.zh: 這封電子郵件直接進了我的垃圾郵件匣。

ex.en: I get a lot of spam every day.
ex.zh: 我每天都收到很多垃圾郵件。

spam.en: unwanted messages sent in large numbers by email or online

ex.en: Please don't spam the group chat.
ex.zh: 請不要在群組裡洗版。

ex.en: Someone has been spamming our customers.
ex.zh: 有人一直在對我們的客戶發送垃圾訊息。

spam.en: to send or post the same unwanted message many times online

ex.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
ex.zh: 這是一家專門服務學生的店。

ex.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
ex.zh: 會議將在一間特別挑選的教堂舉行。

ex.en: I made this cake specially for you.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕是我特地為你做的。

ex.en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
ex.zh: 我把咖啡灑在地毯上了。

ex.en: Tom admitted to spilling the red wine.
ex.zh: 湯姆承認是他把紅酒打翻的。

ex.en: What did you spill?
ex.zh: 你灑了什麼？

spill.en: to let a liquid flow out of its container by accident

ex.en: Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.
ex.zh: 烤箱內如有液體灑出，應立刻清理，以免留下頑固汙漬。

ex.en: Please wipe up the spill on the floor.
ex.zh: 請把地上灑出來的東西擦乾淨。

spill.en: liquid that has accidentally flowed out of its container

ex.en: The hotel has a spa and a fitness center.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有水療中心和健身中心。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon at the spa.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在做 SPA。

spa.en: a place where people go to relax and look after their bodies, or a hot spring

ex.en: I'll put the data in a spreadsheet.
ex.zh: 我會把資料整理成試算表。

ex.en: Please update the sales spreadsheet by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前更新銷售試算表。

spreadsheet.en: a computer program that shows numbers in rows and columns and does calculations

ex.en: She sprayed some perfume on her wrist.
ex.zh: 她在手腕上噴了點香水。

ex.en: The workers sprayed the walls with paint.
ex.zh: 工人用噴漆噴牆壁。

spray.en: to send out liquid in many tiny drops

ex.en: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
ex.zh: 瑪麗的包包裡帶著防狼噴霧。

ex.en: I bought a bottle of mosquito spray.
ex.zh: 我買了一罐防蚊噴霧。

spray.en: liquid in tiny drops, or a container that sends it out

ex.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶的壽命很短。

ex.en: Children have a short attention span.
ex.zh: 小孩的專注時間很短。

span.en: the length of time something lasts, or the distance from one end to the other

span.zh: 持續、跨越（一段時間或距離）

ex.en: Her career spans thirty years.
ex.zh: 她的職業生涯長達三十年。

ex.en: The bridge spans the river.
ex.zh: 這座橋橫跨那條河。

span.en: to cover a long period of time or distance

ex.en: A company spokesman declined to comment.
ex.zh: 公司發言人拒絕置評。

ex.en: The spokesman said the product would be recalled.
ex.zh: 發言人表示產品將會召回。

spokesman.en: a man who speaks officially for a group or company

ex.en: The survey covered a wide spectrum of opinions.
ex.zh: 這份調查涵蓋了各式各樣的意見。

ex.en: People from across the political spectrum supported the plan.
ex.zh: 各種政治立場的人都支持這項計畫。

spectrum.en: a wide range of different ideas, qualities or things

ex.en: A rainbow shows all the colors of the spectrum.
ex.zh: 彩虹呈現出光譜中所有的顏色。

ex.en: The government sold new 5G spectrum to mobile carriers.
ex.zh: 政府把新的 5G 頻譜賣給電信業者。

spectrum.en: the set of colors in a rainbow, or a range of radio waves

ex.en: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
ex.zh: 他被懷疑是間諜。

ex.en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
ex.zh: 我突然想到，他可能是個商業間諜。

ex.en: One of them is a spy.
ex.zh: 他們其中一人是間諜。

spy.en: a person who secretly collects information about another country or group

ex.en: The app was secretly spying on its users.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式一直在暗中監視使用者。

ex.en: Someone has been spying on our emails.
ex.zh: 有人一直在偷看我們的電子郵件。

spy.en: to secretly watch someone or collect information about them

ex.en: Speculative buyers drove up housing prices.
ex.zh: 投機買家推高了房價。

ex.en: Bitcoin is a highly speculative investment.
ex.zh: 比特幣是高度投機的投資。

speculative.en: done in the hope of making money, with a risk of losing it

ex.en: The report is purely speculative.
ex.zh: 這份報導純屬推測。

ex.en: Most of the article is speculative.
ex.zh: 這篇文章大部分內容都是揣測。

speculative.en: based on guesses and not on facts

ex.en: More money for education will spur economic growth.
ex.zh: 增加教育經費將會刺激經濟成長。

ex.en: Lower prices spurred demand for the product.
ex.zh: 降價刺激了這項產品的需求。

spur.en: to make something happen faster or more strongly

spur.zh: on the spur of the moment：一時興起、臨時起意

ex.en: We booked the trip on the spur of the moment.
ex.zh: 我們一時興起就訂了這趟旅行。

ex.en: I bought the jacket on the spur of the moment.
ex.zh: 我一時衝動買了這件外套。

ex.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
ex.zh: 一點火花讓火藥爆炸了。

ex.en: The dog was frightened by the sparks.
ex.zh: 那隻狗被火花嚇到了。

spark.en: a tiny bit of fire that jumps out of something burning

ex.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
ex.zh: 我的評論在小組裡引發了一場爭論。

ex.en: The news sparked interest among investors.
ex.zh: 這則消息引起了投資人的興趣。

ex.en: These fireworks are spectacular!
ex.zh: 這些煙火真壯觀！

ex.en: The view from the top of the mountain is spectacular.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色非常壯觀。

ex.en: The company achieved spectacular growth last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年成長驚人。

spectacular.en: very impressive and exciting to look at

ex.en: I am speculating that he may win the game.
ex.zh: 我推測他可能會贏得比賽。

ex.en: It's too early to speculate about the cause.
ex.zh: 現在推測原因還太早。

speculate.en: to guess about something without knowing all the facts

ex.en: He made a lot of money speculating on real estate.
ex.zh: 他靠炒房賺了很多錢。

ex.en: Many investors speculate in cryptocurrency.
ex.zh: 許多投資人投機炒作加密貨幣。

speculate.en: to buy things in the hope of selling them later for more money

ex.en: Her specialization is international tax law.
ex.zh: 她的專長是國際稅法。

ex.en: What was your specialization in graduate school?
ex.zh: 你研究所時主修什麼領域？

specialization.en: a particular subject that someone studies or knows a lot about

ex.en: Specialization allows workers to become more efficient.
ex.zh: 專業分工讓員工變得更有效率。

ex.en: The industry is moving toward greater specialization.
ex.zh: 這個產業正朝更高度的專業化發展。

specialization.en: the process of focusing on one particular kind of work or activity

ex.en: Speculators pushed up housing prices in the city.
ex.zh: 投機客把城裡的房價炒高了。

ex.en: Currency speculators made huge profits last month.
ex.zh: 外匯投機客上個月賺了大錢。

speculator.en: a person who buys things hoping to sell them later for more money

ex.en: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
ex.zh: 估算一下你在書上花了多少錢。

ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 那家公司在廣告上花了很多錢。

ex.en: She spends a lot of time practicing the piano.
ex.zh: 她花很多時間練鋼琴。

ex.en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天看這本小說。

spend.en: to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
ex.zh: 她英語說得比班上任何同學都好。

ex.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
ex.zh: 全世界許多國家都說英語。

ex.en: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
ex.zh: 說英語時不要怕犯錯。

speak.en: to be able to talk in a particular language

speak.zh: 說話、演講；（電話中）找某人

ex.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合說話。

ex.en: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
ex.zh: 教授講得太快，沒有人聽得懂。

ex.en: May I speak to Mr. Chen, please?
ex.zh: 請問陳先生在嗎？

speak.en: to talk to people, or to give a talk

ex.en: I have a special relationship with my aunt.
ex.zh: 我和阿姨的感情很特別。

ex.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
ex.zh: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。

ex.en: We want to give special thanks to Tom.
ex.zh: 我們要特別感謝湯姆。

special.en: better or more important than usual

ex.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.
ex.zh: 做這件事需要特殊工具。

ex.en: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
ex.zh: 先生，那張 CD 要特別訂購才有。

special.en: made or used for one particular purpose

ex.en: Today's special is beef noodle soup.
ex.zh: 今日特餐是牛肉麵。

ex.en: The store has a special on coffee this week.
ex.zh: 這家店這週咖啡特價。

special.en: a meal or price offered for a limited time

ex.en: There's no space in the room for another bed.
ex.zh: 房間裡沒有空間再放一張床了。

ex.en: There is enough space for ten cars.
ex.zh: 這裡有足夠空間停十輛車。

ex.en: Please leave some space between the lines.
ex.zh: 請在行與行之間留一些空間。

space.en: an empty area that is available for use

ex.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.
ex.zh: 地球只是懸浮在太空中的一顆球體。

ex.en: He was the first man to float in space.
ex.zh: 他是第一個在太空中漂浮的人。

ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
ex.zh: 太空競賽是歷史上令人振奮的時期。

space.en: the area beyond the earth where the stars and planets are

ex.en: Soccer is the most popular of all sports.
ex.zh: 足球是最受歡迎的運動。

ex.en: Soccer is the most popular sport in Brazil.
ex.zh: 足球是巴西最受歡迎的運動。

ex.en: Not only does he like music, he also likes sports.
ex.zh: 他不只喜歡音樂，也喜歡運動。

sport.en: a physical game or activity done for fun or competition

ex.en: Ali works as a sports columnist for the newspaper.
ex.zh: 阿里是報社的體育專欄作家。

ex.en: They sell sporting goods.
ex.zh: 他們賣運動用品。

sport.en: relating to physical games and competitions

ex.en: Could you tell me what your specific requirements are?
ex.zh: 可以說說您的具體需求嗎？

ex.en: Can you be more specific?
ex.zh: 可以說得更具體一點嗎？

ex.en: Let's study a specific example.
ex.zh: 我們來研究一個具體的例子。

ex.en: This offer is only for specific products.
ex.zh: 這項優惠只適用於特定產品。

ex.en: Each team has a specific task.
ex.zh: 每個團隊都有特定的任務。

specific.en: relating to one particular thing only

ex.en: Tom and Mary practiced their speeches in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗對著鏡子練習演講。

ex.en: Unfortunately I was not in time for his speech.
ex.zh: 很可惜我沒趕上他的演講。

ex.en: He is used to making speeches.
ex.zh: 他很習慣上台演講。

speech.en: a formal talk given to a group of people

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a basic right.
ex.zh: 言論自由是一項基本權利。

ex.en: Her speech was slow after the accident.
ex.zh: 意外之後她說話變得很慢。

speech.en: the ability to talk, or the way someone talks

ex.en: In towns, speed is limited to 50 km/h.
ex.zh: 在市區，速限是每小時五十公里。

ex.en: He was driving the car at full speed.
ex.zh: 他全速開著車。

ex.en: The internet speed here is very slow.
ex.zh: 這裡的網速很慢。

speed.en: how fast something moves or happens

ex.en: Ken was fined 7,000 yen for speeding.
ex.zh: 肯因為超速被罰了七千日圓。

ex.en: The policeman arrested him for speeding.
ex.zh: 警察因為他超速而逮捕他。

speed.en: to travel faster than the legal limit

ex.en: Come on, Arianna, speed up or we'll never get there!
ex.zh: 快點啦，艾莉安娜，加快速度，不然我們永遠到不了！

ex.en: We need to speed up the approval process.
ex.zh: 我們需要加快審核流程。

speed.en: to move or happen faster, or to make something do so

ex.en: Many foreign tourists consider Ximending one of the must-visit spots in Taipei.
ex.zh: 許多外國觀光客把西門町列為台北必去的景點之一。

ex.en: The lake is deepest at this spot.
ex.zh: 湖在這個地方最深。

ex.en: This is a great spot for a picnic.
ex.zh: 這是野餐的好地點。

ex.en: There were ten police officers on the spot.
ex.zh: 現場有十名警察。

ex.en: He was offered the job on the spot.
ex.zh: 他當場就被錄取了。

spot.en: at the exact place where something happens, or right away

ex.en: He is good at spotting young talent.
ex.zh: 他很擅長發掘年輕人才。

ex.en: Can you spot the mistake in this sentence?
ex.zh: 你能找出這個句子裡的錯誤嗎？

spot.en: to see or notice someone or something, often by looking carefully

ex.en: A leopard never changes its spots.
ex.zh: 豹改不了身上的斑點（本性難移）。

ex.en: There's a spot of coffee on your shirt.
ex.zh: 你的襯衫上有一塊咖啡漬。

spot.en: a small round mark that has a different color from the area around it

ex.en: Ebola spreads from person to person through bodily fluids.
ex.zh: 伊波拉病毒透過體液在人與人之間傳播。

ex.en: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.
ex.zh: 這些措施可以防止疾病蔓延。

ex.en: The cancer has spread to her stomach.
ex.zh: 癌細胞已經擴散到她的胃。

spread.en: to reach more and more people or places

ex.en: She spread the clean bedsheet on the bed.
ex.zh: 她把乾淨的床單鋪在床上。

ex.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.
ex.zh: 我們分散開來，開始搜索樹林。

ex.en: Spread some butter on the bread.
ex.zh: 在麵包上塗一些奶油。

spread.en: to open something out flat, or to put a thin layer of something over a surface

ex.en: We must stop the spread of the virus.
ex.zh: 我們必須阻止病毒擴散。

ex.en: The spread of the internet changed our lives.
ex.zh: 網路的普及改變了我們的生活。

spread.en: the process of reaching more people or a wider area

ex.en: The speaker thanked the audience at the end.
ex.zh: 演講者在最後感謝觀眾。

ex.en: She was invited as a guest speaker at the conference.
ex.zh: 她受邀擔任研討會的客座講者。

speaker.en: a person who gives a talk to an audience

ex.en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
ex.zh: 我跟英語母語人士學了四年英文。

ex.en: Tom is a fluent speaker of Japanese.
ex.zh: 湯姆日語說得很流利。

ex.en: He is a very good speaker of English.
ex.zh: 他英文說得非常好。

speaker.en: a person who can talk in a particular language

ex.en: I bought a set of brand new speakers.
ex.zh: 我買了一套全新的喇叭。

ex.en: I need new speakers for my PC.
ex.zh: 我的電腦需要新喇叭。

speaker.en: a device that plays sound out loud

ex.en: What he did really shows the right spirit!
ex.zh: 他這麼做真是精神可嘉！

ex.en: We need more team spirit in this office.
ex.zh: 我們辦公室需要更多團隊精神。

spirit.en: the attitude or feeling that people show in what they do

ex.en: She was in high spirits after the interview.
ex.zh: 面試之後她心情非常好。

ex.en: The good news lifted our spirits.
ex.zh: 這個好消息讓我們精神一振。

spirit.en: the way a person feels, happy or sad, at a certain time

ex.en: Ivan can see the ghost spirits.
ex.zh: 伊萬看得見鬼魂。

ex.en: There are rumors that some evil spirits linger around here.
ex.zh: 傳說這附近有惡靈出沒。

spirit.en: the part of a person believed to live on after death, or a ghost

ex.en: The first time he came to Taipei, he specifically wanted to go shopping in Ximending.
ex.zh: 他第一次來台北，就特地要去西門町逛街。

ex.en: This course is designed specifically for beginners.
ex.zh: 這門課是專門為初學者設計的。

specifically.en: for one particular purpose or reason

ex.en: I specifically asked you not to be late.
ex.zh: 我明確地叫你不要遲到。

ex.en: Can you tell me specifically what the problem is?
ex.zh: 你能具體告訴我問題出在哪裡嗎？

specifically.en: in a clear and exact way

ex.en: What do you usually do in your spare time?
ex.zh: 你空閒時通常做什麼？

ex.en: What do you like doing in your spare time?
ex.zh: 你空閒時喜歡做什麼？

spare.en: not busy and free to be used as you like

ex.en: We are making spare parts in a car factory.
ex.zh: 我們在一家汽車工廠生產備用零件。

ex.en: Do you have a spare key?
ex.zh: 你有備用鑰匙嗎？

spare.en: kept in addition to what is needed, ready for use if necessary

ex.en: Can you spare a few minutes to talk?
ex.zh: 你可以撥幾分鐘聊一下嗎？

ex.en: I can't spare any time this week.
ex.zh: 我這週抽不出時間。

spare.en: to give time or money that you can manage to give

ex.en: He spared no pains to help me.
ex.zh: 他不遺餘力地幫助我。

ex.en: We will spare no effort to meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 我們會不遺餘力趕上截止期限。

spare.en: to try as hard as possible to do something

ex.en: He arrived five minutes after the specified time.
ex.zh: 他比指定時間晚了五分鐘到。

ex.en: Tom didn't specify what he wanted.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒說清楚他想要什麼。

ex.en: Please specify the size and color when ordering.
ex.zh: 訂購時請註明尺寸和顏色。

specify.en: to say or write exactly what is wanted or needed

ex.en: Why does the Earth spin?
ex.zh: 地球為什麼會自轉？

ex.en: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?
ex.zh: 如果地球停止自轉，你認為會發生什麼事？

ex.en: The washing machine spins the clothes dry.
ex.zh: 洗衣機把衣服轉乾（脫水）。

spin.en: to turn around and around quickly

ex.en: Let's take the new car for a spin.
ex.zh: 我們開新車去兜一圈吧。

ex.en: The skater finished with a fast spin.
ex.zh: 那位溜冰選手以一個快速旋轉結束表演。

spin.en: a turning movement, or a short trip for fun in a car

ex.en: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
ex.zh: 這家出版社專門出版兒童文學。

ex.en: She specializes in tax law.
ex.zh: 她專攻稅法。

ex.en: Our company specializes in software design.
ex.zh: 我們公司專門從事軟體設計。

specialize.en: to spend most of your time and effort on one subject or activity

ex.en: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.
ex.zh: 這種蝴蝶已經絕種了。

ex.en: The dodo is an already extinct species.
ex.zh: 渡渡鳥是已經滅絕的物種。

ex.en: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
ex.zh: 大貓熊是一種存活至今的古老動物物種。

species.en: a group of animals or plants of the same kind

ex.en: Architects need good spatial awareness.
ex.zh: 建築師需要良好的空間感。

ex.en: The map shows the spatial distribution of our stores.
ex.zh: 這張地圖顯示我們門市的空間分布。

spatial.en: relating to the size, shape and position of things in space

ex.en: The lab tested a blood specimen.
ex.zh: 實驗室檢驗了一份血液樣本。

ex.en: The museum has specimens of rare insects.
ex.zh: 博物館有稀有昆蟲的標本。

specimen.en: a small amount or example of something taken for testing or study

ex.en: A sperm cell is much smaller than an egg.
ex.zh: 精子比卵子小得多。

ex.en: The study examined sperm quality in men.
ex.zh: 這項研究檢驗了男性的精子品質。

sperm.en: a male cell that can join with an egg to make a baby

ex.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.
ex.zh: 地球只不過是懸浮在太空中的一個球體。

ex.en: Then people knew, that the world is a sphere.
ex.zh: 那時人們就知道地球是圓的。

sphere.en: a round object like a ball

ex.en: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.
ex.zh: 他試圖擴大自己的勢力範圍。

ex.en: The subject is out of his sphere.
ex.zh: 這個主題超出了他的專業領域。

sphere.en: an area of activity, interest or power

ex.en: The editor spliced the two scenes together.
ex.zh: 剪輯師把兩個場景剪接在一起。

ex.en: The technician spliced the broken cables.
ex.zh: 技術人員把斷掉的電纜接起來。

splice.en: to join two pieces of something together at their ends

ex.en: We took a spontaneous trip to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們臨時起意去了海邊。

ex.en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
ex.zh: 觀眾自發地熱烈鼓掌。

spontaneous.en: done suddenly because you want to, without planning

ex.en: Tom found a wonderful spouse in Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆找到了瑪麗這麼好的另一半。

ex.en: Employees and their spouses are invited to the party.
ex.zh: 員工和配偶都受邀參加派對。

ex.en: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.
ex.zh: 韓國菜以辣聞名。

ex.en: Tom doesn't like any kind of spicy food.
ex.zh: 湯姆不喜歡任何辣的食物。

ex.en: I don't mind if it's hot and spicy.
ex.zh: 辣一點沒關係。

spicy.en: having a hot taste, like chili or black pepper

ex.en: Let's split the bill today.
ex.zh: 今天我們各付各的吧。

ex.en: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.
ex.zh: 這筆報酬我們對半分吧。

split.en: to divide something and share it between people

ex.en: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."
ex.zh: 「你們不是結婚了嗎？」「喔，我們分手了，婚約也取消了。」

ex.en: They split up after five years together.
ex.zh: 他們在一起五年後分手了。

split.en: to end a relationship with someone

ex.en: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
ex.zh: 一聲尖銳的雷響劃破了天空。

ex.en: He split the wood with an axe.
ex.zh: 他用斧頭劈柴。

split.en: to break into two or more parts, usually along a line

ex.en: He's a specialist in economics.
ex.zh: 他是經濟學專家。

ex.en: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
ex.zh: 專家就像一把只有一根弦的小提琴。

ex.en: My doctor sent me to a heart specialist.
ex.zh: 我的醫生讓我去看心臟專科醫師。

specialist.en: a person with a lot of knowledge or skill in one subject

ex.en: Don't read the comments. They're full of spoilers.
ex.zh: 別看留言，裡面全是雷。

ex.en: No spoilers, please! I haven't seen it yet.
ex.zh: 拜託別爆雷！我還沒看。

spoiler.en: information that tells you what happens in a story before you see it

ex.en: There weren't many spectators at the game because of the rain.
ex.zh: 因為下雨，球場上觀眾不多。

ex.en: Thousands of spectators watched the race.
ex.zh: 上千名觀眾觀看了這場比賽。

spectator.en: a person who watches a game or event

ex.en: Spring is here. It is getting warmer every day.
ex.zh: 春天來了，天氣一天比一天暖和。

ex.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
ex.zh: 春節也就是農曆新年。

spring.en: the season after winter when the weather gets warmer

ex.en: There are a lot of hot springs in Japan.
ex.zh: 日本有很多溫泉。

ex.en: We went to Beitou to soak in the hot springs.
ex.zh: 我們去北投泡溫泉。

spring.en: a place where water comes up naturally from the ground

ex.en: The old mattress has broken springs.
ex.zh: 這張舊床墊的彈簧壞了。

ex.en: The toy jumps when you press the spring.
ex.zh: 按一下彈簧，玩具就會跳起來。

spring.en: a piece of curled metal that returns to its shape after being pressed

ex.en: I never saw such a splendid sunset.
ex.zh: 我從沒見過那麼壯麗的日落景色。

ex.en: What a splendid dinner!
ex.zh: 多麼出色的晚飯啊！

ex.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
ex.zh: 寒冷乾燥，燦爛的陽光，多麼美麗的冬日天氣!

ex.en: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
ex.zh: 決定我們人生的不是物質，而是精神上的東西。

ex.en: Some patients find spiritual comfort in prayer.
ex.zh: 有些病人從禱告中得到心靈上的慰藉。

ex.en: Good health includes both physical and spiritual well-being.
ex.zh: 真正的健康包括身體和心靈的安適。

spiritual.en: relating to a person's deep inner life or religion, not the body or material things

ex.en: In Singapore, it is a crime to spit on the ground.
ex.zh: 在新加坡，隨地吐痰是違法的。

ex.en: Spitting is prohibited.
ex.zh: 禁止吐痰。

ex.en: He has the habit of spitting on the ground.
ex.zh: 他有個隨地吐痰的習慣。

spit.en: to send liquid or food out of your mouth

ex.en: The doctor took a sample of spit to test for the virus.
ex.zh: 醫生採集了唾液樣本來檢驗病毒。

ex.en: There was spit on the floor of the bus.
ex.zh: 公車地板上有口水。

spit.en: the liquid that is made in your mouth

ex.en: I won't participate in speculation.
ex.zh: 我不會參與揣測。

ex.en: There is a lot of speculation about who will be the next CEO.
ex.zh: 大家都在猜下一任執行長會是誰。

speculation.en: guesses about something when you do not know the facts

ex.en: Speculation pushed house prices up quickly.
ex.zh: 投機炒作讓房價迅速上漲。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in land speculation.
ex.zh: 他炒地皮賠了一大筆錢。

speculation.en: buying things in the hope of selling them later for more money

ex.en: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.
ex.zh: 我覺得這家贊助商不太合適。

ex.en: The bank is the main sponsor of the marathon.
ex.zh: 這家銀行是馬拉松的主要贊助商。

sponsor.en: a person or company that pays for an event or team, often to get attention

ex.en: A local company sponsored the concert.
ex.zh: 一家本地公司贊助了這場音樂會。

ex.en: The event is sponsored by the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動由市政府贊助。

sponsor.en: to pay for an event, team or person, often to get attention

ex.en: The team is looking for sponsorship.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍正在找贊助。

ex.en: The event was made possible by the sponsorship of several companies.
ex.zh: 多家公司的贊助讓這場活動得以舉辦。

sponsorship.en: money that a person or company gives to support an event or team

ex.en: The living room in my new house is very spacious.
ex.zh: 我新家的客廳很寬敞。

ex.en: The hotel rooms are bright and spacious.
ex.zh: 飯店的房間明亮又寬敞。

spacious.en: having a lot of room inside

ex.en: Please check the technical specifications before ordering.
ex.zh: 訂購前請確認技術規格。

ex.en: The product does not meet our specifications.
ex.zh: 這項產品不符合我們的規格。

specification.en: a detailed description of how something should be made or what it must do

ex.en: The payment division became a spin-off after the company reorganized.
ex.zh: 公司重整後，支付部門成為一家衍生公司。

ex.en: The spin-off now develops software for small banks.
ex.zh: 這家分拆成立的公司現在為小型銀行開發軟體。

spin-off.en: a new company that is formed from part of a larger company

ex.en: The technician ordered spare parts before servicing the aging machines.
ex.zh: 技術人員在維修老舊機器前先訂購了備用零件。

ex.en: Without the correct spare part, the repair had to wait until Monday.
ex.zh: 缺少合適的備用零件，維修只能等到星期一。

spare part.en: a part kept to replace one that is broken in a machine

ex.en: I sprained my finger while playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我打排球的時候扭傷了手指。

ex.en: Tom sprained his wrist.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了手腕。

ex.en: Tom sprained his ankle.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了腳踝。

sprain.en: to hurt a joint by twisting it suddenly

ex.en: Could you speak up? I can't hear you.
ex.zh: 可以說大聲一點嗎？我聽不到。

ex.en: Please speak up so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 請說大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到。

speak up.en: to talk more loudly so people can hear

ex.en: If you have any trouble, please speak up.
ex.zh: 有任何問題，請直接說出來。

ex.en: If you disagree, you should speak up.
ex.zh: 如果你不同意，就應該說出來。

speak up.en: to say what you think openly

ex.en: I don't know how to spell the word.
ex.zh: 我不知道這個單詞怎麼拼寫。

ex.en: Well, I'll tell you how to spell my name.
ex.zh: 好，我告訴你我的名字怎麼拼。

ex.en: That's not how my name is spelled.
ex.zh: 我的名字不是這樣拼的。

spell.en: to say or write the letters of a word in the right order

ex.en: I get dizzy spells when I stand up.
ex.zh: 我一站起來就覺得頭暈。

ex.en: We had a spell of cold weather last week.
ex.zh: 上週有一波寒流。

spell.en: a short period of time when something happens

ex.en: The witch cast a spell on the prince.
ex.zh: 女巫對王子施了咒語。

ex.en: The music held the audience under its spell.
ex.zh: 音樂讓觀眾聽得如痴如醉。

spell.en: magic words, or the power that they give

ex.en: Government spending on schools has increased this year.
ex.zh: 今年政府在學校方面的支出增加了。

ex.en: I need to keep my monthly spending under control.
ex.zh: 我需要控制每個月的開銷。

ex.en: Don't let one bad day spoil your whole trip.
ex.zh: 別讓一天的壞心情毀了整趟旅行。

ex.en: The heavy rain spoiled our picnic plans.
ex.zh: 大雨破壞了我們的野餐計畫。

ex.en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren with sweets.
ex.zh: 祖父母常常用糖果寵壞孫子孫女。

ex.en: If you give her everything, you'll spoil her.
ex.zh: 如果你什麼都給她，會把她寵壞的。

ex.en: Milk spoils quickly if you leave it out of the fridge.
ex.zh: 牛奶沒放進冰箱很快就會變質。

ex.en: The fruit spoiled because of the hot weather.
ex.zh: 因為天氣炎熱，水果壞掉了。

ex.en: Use a spoon to eat the soup.
ex.zh: 用湯匙喝湯。

ex.en: She stirred her coffee with a small spoon.
ex.zh: 她用小湯匙攪拌咖啡。

ex.en: He spooned some rice onto my plate.
ex.zh: 他用湯匙舀了一些飯到我的盤子上。

ex.en: Spoon the sauce over the noodles and serve.
ex.zh: 把醬汁淋在麵上就可以上桌了。

ex.en: Sitting for too long can hurt your spine.
ex.zh: 坐太久可能會傷到脊椎。

ex.en: She felt a chill run down her spine.
ex.zh: 她感到一陣寒意從脊背竄下。

ex.en: The title is printed on the spine of the book.
ex.zh: 書名印在書背上。

ex.en: A cactus has sharp spines to protect itself.
ex.zh: 仙人掌長有尖刺來保護自己。

ex.en: Sprinkle some sugar on the cake.
ex.zh: 在蛋糕上撒一些糖。

ex.en: She sprinkled water on the plants.
ex.zh: 她對植物灑了一些水。

ex.en: Add a sprinkle of salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一點點鹽。

ex.en: There was a light sprinkle in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午下了一陣小雨。

ex.en: Spain is a country in the south west of Europe.
ex.zh: 西班牙是位於歐洲西南部的國家。

ex.en: Many people visit Spain in summer for the beaches.
ex.zh: 許多人夏天到西班牙享受海灘。

ex.en: She speaks Spanish fluently after living abroad for years.
ex.zh: 她在國外住了幾年，西班牙語說得很流利。

ex.en: The Spanish are known for late dinners and lively festivals.
ex.zh: 西班牙人以晚餐吃得晚和熱鬧的慶典聞名。

ex.en: We tried a Spanish rice dish at the new restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在新餐廳試了一道西班牙的飯類料理。

ex.en: Her Spanish teacher gave us a short test today.
ex.zh: 她的西班牙文老師今天出了一個小考。

ex.en: Spencer is a surname that is also used as a first name.
ex.zh: 史賓賽是個姓氏，也被當作男孩的名字。

ex.en: The name Spencer once meant a person who handled supplies.
ex.zh: 史賓賽這個名字原本指的是管理物資的人。

ex.en: The fireworks over the harbor were a wonderful spectacle.
ex.zh: 港口上空的煙火是個美妙的壯觀景象。

ex.en: Thousands of birds taking off at once was quite a spectacle.
ex.zh: 成千上萬隻鳥同時起飛，場面十分壯觀。

spectacle.zh: 丟臉的場面（make a spectacle of oneself）

ex.en: He made a spectacle of himself by shouting at the waiter.
ex.zh: 他對著服務生大吼大叫，鬧了個大笑話。

ex.en: Don't make a spectacle of yourself at the wedding.
ex.zh: 在婚禮上別讓自己出醜。

ex.en: My grandfather wears spectacles when he reads the newspaper.
ex.zh: 我爺爺看報紙時會戴眼鏡。

ex.en: She cleaned her spectacles with a soft cloth.
ex.zh: 她用軟布擦拭她的眼鏡。

ex.en: The shop specialises in handmade leather bags.
ex.zh: 這家店專門販售手工皮包。

ex.en: She wants to specialise in children's medicine.
ex.zh: 她想專攻兒童醫學。

ex.en: Many students specialise after their second year of college.
ex.zh: 許多學生在大學二年級之後會選定專攻領域。

ex.en: Please arrive at the specified time.
ex.zh: 請在指定的時間抵達。

ex.en: The form must be sent to the specified address.
ex.zh: 表格必須寄到指定的地址。

ex.en: Each student received a specified amount of paper.
ex.zh: 每位學生都領到規定數量的紙。

ex.en: Fixing this machine requires specialized tools.
ex.zh: 修理這台機器需要專門的工具。

ex.en: She works at a specialized hospital for children.
ex.zh: 她在一家兒童專科醫院工作。

ex.en: He has specialized knowledge about old clocks.
ex.zh: 他對古董鐘錶有專門的知識。

ex.en: He works at a store that sells sporting goods.
ex.zh: 他在一家賣運動用品的店工作。

ex.en: The city will hold a big sporting event next month.
ex.zh: 這座城市下個月將舉辦一場大型體育賽事。

ex.en: It was sporting of him to shake hands after losing.
ex.zh: 他輸了還跟對手握手，很有運動家風度。

ex.en: She made a sporting offer to play the game again.
ex.zh: 她很大方地提議重賽一次。

ex.en: A bright spotlight followed the singer across the stage.
ex.zh: 一道明亮的聚光燈跟著歌手在舞台上移動。

ex.en: The theater turned off the lights except for one spotlight.
ex.zh: 劇院關掉了所有燈，只留下一盞聚光燈。

ex.en: The young actress is now in the spotlight.
ex.zh: 那位年輕女演員現在成了眾人矚目的焦點。

ex.en: He doesn't like being in the spotlight.
ex.zh: 他不喜歡成為注目的焦點。

ex.en: A spider built a web in the corner of the window.
ex.zh: 一隻蜘蛛在窗戶角落結了網。

ex.en: My sister screamed when she saw a big spider in the bathroom.
ex.zh: 我妹妹在浴室看到一隻大蜘蛛時尖叫起來。

ex.en: Pepper is one of the most common spices in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 胡椒是廚房裡最常見的香料之一。

ex.en: The soup needs a little more spice.
ex.zh: 這碗湯需要再多加一點香料。

ex.en: She spiced the soup with ginger and chili.
ex.zh: 她用薑和辣椒為湯調味。

ex.en: He spiced up his speech with a few funny stories.
ex.zh: 他用幾個有趣的故事為演講增添趣味。

ex.en: Her spelling is perfect, and she never makes mistakes in essays.
ex.zh: 她的拼字很完美，作文從不出錯。

ex.en: There are two different spellings of this word in English.
ex.zh: 這個字在英文裡有兩種不同的拼法。

ex.en: We have a spelling test every Friday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週五早上都有拼字測驗。

ex.en: The hospital has a specialised team for heart surgery.
ex.zh: 這間醫院有專門負責心臟手術的團隊。

ex.en: You need specialised tools to fix this machine.
ex.zh: 你需要專用的工具來修理這台機器。

ex.en: She works in a highly specialised field of science.
ex.zh: 她從事的是一個高度專門化的科學領域。

ex.en: A company spokeswoman said the problem would be fixed soon.
ex.zh: 公司的女發言人表示問題很快就會修好。

ex.en: The spokeswoman answered questions from reporters for an hour.
ex.zh: 女發言人回答了記者一個小時的提問。

ex.en: The spacecraft will land on the moon next year.
ex.zh: 這艘太空船明年將登陸月球。

ex.en: Engineers tested the spacecraft before the launch.
ex.zh: 工程師在發射前測試了這艘太空船。

ex.en: Many people find spirituality through meditation and quiet walks.
ex.zh: 許多人透過冥想和安靜的散步找到心靈的寄託。

ex.en: Her spirituality gives her strength during hard times.
ex.zh: 她的心靈信念在艱難時刻給她力量。

ex.en: Salmon return to the river to spawn every autumn.
ex.zh: 鮭魚每年秋天回到河裡產卵。

ex.en: The fish spawn in shallow, warm water.
ex.zh: 這些魚在淺而溫暖的水域產卵。

ex.en: The popular movie spawned several sequels.
ex.zh: 這部熱門電影催生了好幾部續集。

ex.en: Bad weather can spawn a lot of traffic jams.
ex.zh: 壞天氣可能引發大量的塞車。

ex.en: Frog spawn floated in the pond in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時池塘裡漂著蛙卵。

ex.en: The fish lay their spawn among the plants.
ex.zh: 這些魚把卵產在水草之間。

ex.en: The kids splashed water on each other at the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子們在游泳池裡互相潑水。

ex.en: Rain splashed against the window all night.
ex.zh: 雨水整夜拍打著窗戶。

ex.en: The stone fell into the pond with a loud splash.
ex.zh: 石頭「撲通」一聲掉進池塘。

ex.en: A splash of cold water woke him up.
ex.zh: 一點冷水濺到臉上讓他醒了過來。

ex.en: Add a splash of lemon juice to the tea.
ex.zh: 在茶裡加一點檸檬汁。

ex.en: The room needs a splash of color.
ex.zh: 這個房間需要一點色彩點綴。

ex.en: Her spoken English is better than her written English.
ex.zh: 她的英語口說比寫作更好。

ex.en: The test has a spoken part and a written part.
ex.zh: 這場考試有口說部分和筆試部分。

ex.en: She has spoken to the manager about the problem.
ex.zh: 她已經就這個問題和經理談過了。

ex.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多國家都使用英語。

ex.en: Fresh fish is the speciality of this little restaurant.
ex.zh: 新鮮的魚是這間小餐廳的招牌菜。

ex.en: Cheese is a regional speciality in this part of the country.
ex.zh: 起司是這個地區的特產。

ex.en: Her speciality is children's health, so she works at a clinic.
ex.zh: 她專攻兒童健康，所以在診所工作。

ex.en: Computers are not my speciality, so I asked an expert.
ex.zh: 電腦不是我的專長，所以我請教了專家。

ex.en: I added fresh spinach to the pasta.
ex.zh: 我在義大利麵裡加了新鮮菠菜。

ex.en: Spinach is full of iron and vitamins.
ex.zh: 菠菜富含鐵質與維生素。

ex.en: The fence had sharp spikes along the top.
ex.zh: 圍欄頂端有尖銳的長釘。

ex.en: Runners wear shoes with spikes on the bottom.
ex.zh: 跑者穿鞋底有釘的鞋。

ex.en: There was a sudden spike in sales before the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期前銷售量突然暴增。

ex.en: The doctor noticed a spike in his blood pressure.
ex.zh: 醫生發現他的血壓突然升高。

ex.en: Prices spiked after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後物價暴漲。

ex.en: His temperature spiked to 39 degrees last night.
ex.zh: 他昨晚的體溫突然升到三十九度。

ex.en: The sprawling city spreads across the whole valley.
ex.zh: 這座向外蔓延的城市占滿了整個山谷。

ex.en: They live in a sprawling house with many rooms.
ex.zh: 他們住在一棟房間很多、占地寬廣的房子。

ex.en: We wish you a speedy recovery.
ex.zh: 我們祝你早日康復。

ex.en: The company promised a speedy reply to every email.
ex.zh: 公司承諾每封電子郵件都會迅速回覆。

ex.en: The sparkling lake looked beautiful in the morning sun.
ex.zh: 閃閃發亮的湖水在晨光下十分美麗。

ex.en: She wore a sparkling necklace to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條閃亮的項鍊去參加派對。

ex.en: I'd like a glass of sparkling water, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯氣泡水。

ex.en: They toasted with sparkling wine at midnight.
ex.zh: 他們在午夜用氣泡酒乾杯。

ex.en: He is a sparkling speaker who keeps the audience laughing.
ex.zh: 他是個談吐風趣生動的演講者，讓聽眾笑聲不斷。

ex.en: The play had sparkling dialogue from start to finish.
ex.zh: 這齣戲從頭到尾的對白都很精彩活潑。

ex.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the counter.
ex.zh: 用濕海綿擦拭流理台。

ex.en: The cake was soft and light like a sponge.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕像海綿一樣柔軟又鬆軟。

ex.en: She sponged the stain off the table.
ex.zh: 她用海綿把桌上的污漬擦掉。

ex.en: He sponged his face with cool water.
ex.zh: 他用海綿蘸涼水擦臉。

ex.en: The seeds will sprout in a few days.
ex.zh: 這些種子幾天內就會發芽。

ex.en: Weeds sprouted between the stones of the path.
ex.zh: 小徑的石頭縫隙間長出了雜草。

ex.en: A tiny green sprout appeared in the pot.
ex.zh: 花盆裡冒出了一顆小小的綠芽。

ex.en: I like to put bean sprouts in my noodle soup.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在湯麵裡加豆芽。

ex.en: He suffered a spinal injury in the accident.
ex.zh: 他在意外中脊椎受了傷。

ex.en: Doctors checked the spinal cord for damage.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查脊髓有沒有受損。

ex.en: A spiral of smoke rose from the chimney.
ex.zh: 一縷螺旋狀的煙從煙囪升起。

ex.en: The shell has a beautiful spiral pattern.
ex.zh: 這個貝殼有漂亮的螺旋紋路。

ex.en: We climbed a spiral staircase to the top of the tower.
ex.zh: 我們沿著螺旋梯爬上塔頂。

ex.en: The notebook has a spiral binding.
ex.zh: 這本筆記本是螺旋裝訂。

ex.en: Prices began to spiral out of control last year.
ex.zh: 去年物價開始失控飆漲。

ex.en: Without help, his debts will spiral.
ex.zh: 若沒有人幫忙，他的債務會急速惡化。

ex.en: The hunter carried a long wooden spear.
ex.zh: 獵人帶著一支長長的木矛。

ex.en: The museum displays an ancient stone spear.
ex.zh: 博物館展示了一支古老的石矛。

ex.en: He speared a fish in the shallow water.
ex.zh: 他在淺水中用矛叉到一條魚。

ex.en: She speared a piece of cheese with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用叉子叉起一塊起司。

ex.en: She won the 100-meter sprint at the school games.
ex.zh: 她在校運會的一百公尺短跑中獲勝。

ex.en: He made a final sprint to the finish line.
ex.zh: 他朝終點線做最後衝刺。

ex.en: I had to sprint to catch the last bus.
ex.zh: 我得全力衝刺才趕得上末班公車。

ex.en: The children sprinted across the yard when the bell rang.
ex.zh: 鐘聲一響，孩子們飛奔穿過院子。

ex.en: He pushed the spade into the soil and turned it over.
ex.zh: 他把鏟子插進土裡並翻土。

ex.en: Bring a spade if you want to plant the tree.
ex.zh: 如果你想種樹，就帶一把鏟子來。

ex.en: She played the ace of spades and won the round.
ex.zh: 她打出黑桃 A，贏了這一局。

ex.en: I need one more spade to finish the set.
ex.zh: 我還差一張黑桃就能湊齊這組牌。

ex.en: The farmers spaded the field before planting the seeds.
ex.zh: 農夫們在播種前先用鏟子翻整田地。

ex.en: She spaded the garden bed and added some compost.
ex.zh: 她用鏟子翻了花圃並加了些堆肥。

ex.en: The crowd spontaneously began to sing.
ex.zh: 群眾自發地開始唱起歌來。

ex.en: We decided spontaneously to drive to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們臨時起意決定開車去海邊。

ex.en: The lake seemed to sparkle in the morning sun.
ex.zh: 湖面在晨光中似乎閃閃發光。

ex.en: Her eyes sparkle whenever she talks about her trip.
ex.zh: 每當她談起那趟旅行，眼睛就閃閃發亮。

ex.en: The diamond ring had a beautiful sparkle.
ex.zh: 那枚鑽戒閃耀著美麗的光芒。

ex.en: The new director brought some sparkle to the old team.
ex.zh: 新導演為這支老團隊帶來了一些活力。

sponsored.zh: 贊助；資助（sponsor 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: A local bank sponsored the school's music festival.
ex.zh: 當地一家銀行贊助了學校的音樂節。

ex.en: They sponsored a child's education for ten years.
ex.zh: 他們資助了一名孩子十年的教育。

ex.en: The race is a sponsored event, so all entry fees go to charity.
ex.zh: 這場賽跑是募款活動，所有報名費都會捐給慈善機構。

ex.en: The sponsored walk raised money for the children's hospital.
ex.zh: 這場募款健走為兒童醫院籌到了款項。

ex.en: A Spaniard sat next to me on the train.
ex.zh: 火車上有一位西班牙人坐在我旁邊。

ex.en: My professor is a Spaniard who teaches art history.
ex.zh: 我的教授是位教藝術史的西班牙人。

ex.en: He is a talented sportsman who plays three different sports.
ex.zh: 他是位很有天分的運動員，會三種不同的運動。

ex.en: A good sportsman accepts defeat with a smile.
ex.zh: 好的運動家會笑著接受失敗。

ex.en: I cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐煮了番茄醬義大利麵。

ex.en: He twisted the spaghetti around his fork.
ex.zh: 他把義大利麵捲在叉子上。

ex.en: The cat sprawled on the sofa in the afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 貓在午後陽光下四腳朝天地躺在沙發上。

ex.en: The city has sprawled out into the countryside.
ex.zh: 這座城市已向鄉間蔓延開來。

ex.en: Urban sprawl has made traffic worse in many cities.
ex.zh: 都市無序擴張讓許多城市的交通更糟。

ex.en: He lay in a sprawl across the whole bed.
ex.zh: 他四肢攤開地橫躺在整張床上。

ex.en: The teacher asked for more specificity in our answers.
ex.zh: 老師要求我們的答案要更明確具體。

ex.en: The test has high specificity for this disease.
ex.zh: 這項檢驗對這種疾病有很高的特異性。

ex.en: The desert has only sparse grass and a few trees.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡只有稀疏的草和幾棵樹。

ex.en: Information about the old village is sparse.
ex.zh: 關於那個古老村莊的資料很少。

ex.en: Tourists admired the splendour of the old palace.
ex.zh: 遊客們讚嘆這座古老宮殿的壯麗。

ex.en: The sunset over the lake was a scene of great splendour.
ex.zh: 湖上的夕陽是一幅壯麗的景象。

spotted.zh: 看見、發現（spot 的過去式）

ex.en: I spotted my friend in the crowd and waved.
ex.zh: 我在人群中看到朋友，就揮手打招呼。

ex.en: The lifeguard spotted a swimmer in trouble.
ex.zh: 救生員發現有一位泳客遇到麻煩。

ex.en: The farmer has a spotted cow with brown patches.
ex.zh: 農夫有一頭帶著褐色斑塊的花斑牛。

ex.en: She wore a spotted dress to the picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件圓點洋裝去野餐。

ex.en: She garnished the soup with a sprig of parsley.
ex.zh: 她用一小枝荷蘭芹來裝飾這碗湯。

ex.en: He picked a sprig of mint from the garden.
ex.zh: 他從花園裡摘了一小枝薄荷。

ex.en: The spinner turned raw wool into thread.
ex.zh: 紡紗工把原毛紡成線。

ex.en: The factory bought a new spinner to make cotton thread faster.
ex.zh: 工廠買了一台新的紡紗機，讓棉線生產得更快。

ex.en: The spinner bowled the ball and it turned sharply.
ex.zh: 旋球手投出球，球急速轉彎。

ex.en: The child played with a colorful spinner on the table.
ex.zh: 孩子在桌上玩一個彩色的陀螺。

ex.en: The church spire could be seen from miles away.
ex.zh: 從好幾英里外就能看見教堂的尖塔。

ex.en: A tall spire rises above the old town.
ex.zh: 一座高高的尖塔聳立在老城上方。

ex.en: There was a speck of dust on the lens.
ex.zh: 鏡頭上有一小粒灰塵。

ex.en: The ship was only a speck on the horizon.
ex.zh: 那艘船在地平線上只是一個小點。

ex.en: The volcano began to spew ash into the sky.
ex.zh: 火山開始往天空噴出火山灰。

ex.en: The broken pipe spewed water across the street.
ex.zh: 破裂的水管把水噴得滿街都是。

ex.en: We admired the splendor of the palace.
ex.zh: 我們讚嘆這座宮殿的壯麗。

ex.en: The mountains shone in all their splendor at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出時群山以其全部的壯麗閃耀著。

spreading.zh: 擴散；蔓延（spread 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The fire is spreading quickly through the forest.
ex.zh: 火勢正迅速在森林中蔓延。

ex.en: Rumors are spreading around the office.
ex.zh: 謠言正在辦公室裡傳開。

spreading.zh: 塗抹；攤開（spread 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is spreading butter on the toast.
ex.zh: 她正把奶油塗在吐司上。

ex.en: He is spreading a map across the table.
ex.zh: 他正把一張地圖攤在桌上。

ex.en: She felt spiritually refreshed after the quiet retreat.
ex.zh: 安靜的靜修之後，她覺得心靈煥然一新。

ex.en: He is not religious, but he considers himself spiritually curious.
ex.zh: 他沒有宗教信仰，但自認在心靈層面充滿好奇。

ex.en: She will spearhead the campaign to clean up the river.
ex.zh: 她將帶頭推動清理河川的活動。

ex.en: The mayor spearheaded efforts to build a new library.
ex.zh: 市長率先推動興建新圖書館的工作。

ex.en: The young engineers were the spearhead of the project.
ex.zh: 年輕的工程師們是這個專案的先鋒。

ex.en: The archaeologists found an ancient spearhead made of stone.
ex.zh: 考古學家發現了一個石製的古代矛頭。

ex.en: She is speaking to the manager right now.
ex.zh: 她現在正在跟經理說話。

ex.en: Who is speaking at tonight's meeting?
ex.zh: 今晚的會議由誰發言？

ex.en: Public speaking makes many people nervous.
ex.zh: 公開演講讓許多人感到緊張。

ex.en: His speaking was clear and easy to follow.
ex.zh: 他的說話方式清楚易懂。

ex.en: "May I speak to Ms. Lin?" "Speaking."
ex.zh: 「請問林小姐在嗎？」「我就是。」

ex.en: "Is this Mr. Chen?" "Speaking. How can I help you?"
ex.zh: 「請問是陳先生嗎？」「我就是，有什麼事嗎？」

sputter.zh: 發出劈啪聲；結結巴巴地說

ex.en: The old engine sputtered and then stopped.
ex.zh: 老舊的引擎噗噗作響後就熄火了。

ex.en: He sputtered an excuse and ran out of the room.
ex.zh: 他結結巴巴地找了個藉口就跑出房間。

ex.en: The villagers said a spectre walked the old road at night.
ex.zh: 村民說夜裡有幽靈在那條老路上遊蕩。

ex.en: The spectre of unemployment worried many families.
ex.zh: 失業的陰影讓許多家庭憂心忡忡。

ex.en: She went on a shopping spree before the holidays.
ex.zh: 她在假期前瘋狂血拚了一回。

ex.en: The boys went on a spending spree with their prize money.
ex.zh: 男孩們拿獎金大肆揮霍了一番。

ex.en: There were sporadic showers throughout the day.
ex.zh: 一整天都有零星的陣雨。

ex.en: We have only sporadic contact with our old classmates.
ex.zh: 我們和老同學只有偶爾的聯絡。

ex.en: Mushrooms spread by releasing millions of tiny spores.
ex.zh: 蘑菇藉由釋放數百萬個微小的孢子來繁殖。

ex.en: The wind carried the spores to the next field.
ex.zh: 風把孢子吹到了隔壁的田裡。

ex.en: The fungus began to spore after the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨之後，那種真菌開始長出孢子。

ex.en: Some ferns spore in late summer.
ex.zh: 有些蕨類在夏末產生孢子。

ex.en: There has been a spate of burglaries in the area.
ex.zh: 這一帶最近接連發生竊案。

ex.en: The company faced a spate of complaints after the update.
ex.zh: 更新之後，公司接連收到一波抱怨。

ex.en: The report was based on spurious claims.
ex.zh: 那份報告是根據不實的說法寫成的。

ex.en: They rejected the spurious argument at once.
ex.zh: 他們立刻駁回了那個站不住腳的論點。

ex.en: The spaceship landed safely on the moon.
ex.zh: 太空船安全降落在月球上。

ex.en: Kids love to draw a spaceship flying past the stars.
ex.zh: 孩子們喜歡畫飛過星星的太空船。

ex.en: A sudden spasm in his back made him cry out.
ex.zh: 他背部突然一陣痙攣，讓他叫出聲來。

ex.en: She felt a muscle spasm in her leg during the run.
ex.zh: 她跑步時腿部肌肉抽筋了。

ex.en: A spectral figure appeared in the old house.
ex.zh: 一個幽靈般的身影出現在老房子裡。

ex.en: The spectral glow of the moon made the forest look strange.
ex.zh: 月亮鬼魅般的光讓森林顯得詭異。

ex.en: Scientists studied the spectral lines of the star.
ex.zh: 科學家研究了這顆恆星的光譜線。

ex.en: The device performs a spectral analysis of light.
ex.zh: 這個裝置對光進行光譜分析。

ex.en: They had a spirited discussion about the new law.
ex.zh: 他們就新法律展開了一場熱烈的討論。

ex.en: The young horse was spirited and hard to control.
ex.zh: 那匹年輕的馬很有活力，不容易控制。

ex.en: A tall spruce stood beside the old house.
ex.zh: 一棵高大的雲杉矗立在老房子旁。

ex.en: We bought a small spruce for Christmas.
ex.zh: 我們買了一棵小雲杉當聖誕樹。

ex.en: He looked spruce in his new suit.
ex.zh: 他穿著新西裝顯得整潔俐落。

ex.en: The little shop looked spruce after a fresh coat of paint.
ex.zh: 小店重新粉刷後顯得整潔清爽。

ex.en: We need to spruce up the living room before the guests arrive.
ex.zh: 客人來之前我們得把客廳整理一下。

ex.en: She spruced herself up for the interview.
ex.zh: 她為了面試把自己打扮得整整齊齊。

ex.en: I got a splinter in my finger from the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 我的手指被木籬笆扎到了一根刺。

ex.en: A splinter of glass lay on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 一片玻璃碎片掉在廚房地板上。

ex.en: The old wood began to splinter when he hit it.
ex.zh: 他敲打時，那塊舊木頭開始裂成碎片。

ex.en: The party might splinter into two groups.
ex.zh: 這個政黨可能會分裂成兩派。

specialisation.zh: 專業化；專精領域（英式拼法）

ex.en: Her area of specialisation is children's education.
ex.zh: 她專精的領域是兒童教育。

ex.en: Specialisation allows workers to become very good at one task.
ex.zh: 分工專業化讓工人能把某項工作做得非常好。

ex.en: Leave equal spacing between the words.
ex.zh: 字與字之間要留相同的間距。

ex.en: The spacing between the trees is about two meters.
ex.zh: 這些樹之間的間距大約是兩公尺。

ex.en: Set the line spacing to double in your essay.
ex.zh: 你的文章要把行距設成雙倍。

ex.en: The poor spacing made the page hard to read.
ex.zh: 間距編排不佳，讓這一頁很難閱讀。

ex.en: The loud noise might spook the horses.
ex.zh: 巨大的聲響可能會嚇到那些馬。

ex.en: Don't spook the cat while she is eating.
ex.zh: 貓咪吃東西時別嚇牠。

ex.en: The kids told stories about a spook in the old house.
ex.zh: 孩子們講著老房子裡有鬼的故事。

ex.en: He dressed up as a friendly spook for the party.
ex.zh: 他為派對打扮成一隻友善的小鬼。

speechless.zh: 說不出話的、啞口無言的

ex.en: The beautiful view left us speechless.
ex.zh: 那片美景讓我們說不出話來。

ex.en: She was speechless with anger after hearing the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息後，她氣得說不出話。

spitfire.zh: 火爆脾氣的人；噴火的東西

ex.en: My grandmother is a little spitfire who always speaks her mind.
ex.zh: 我奶奶是個火爆脾氣的小個子，總是有話直說。

ex.en: The young actress played a spitfire who never backs down.
ex.zh: 這位年輕女演員飾演一個從不退讓的火辣角色。

ex.en: The sprinkler comes on at six every morning to water the lawn.
ex.zh: 灑水器每天早上六點開始替草坪澆水。

ex.en: The fire sprinklers in the hallway went off by mistake.
ex.zh: 走廊的消防灑水系統誤啟動了。

ex.en: Use a spatula to flip the pancakes.
ex.zh: 用鍋鏟把鬆餅翻面。

ex.en: She spread the icing with a small spatula.
ex.zh: 她用小抹刀抹開糖霜。

ex.en: The doctor pressed my tongue down with a spatula.
ex.zh: 醫生用壓舌板壓住我的舌頭。

ex.en: A wooden spatula is used to check the throat.
ex.zh: 檢查喉嚨時會用木製壓舌板。

spooky.zh: 陰森的；令人毛骨悚然的

ex.en: The old house looked spooky at night.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子在夜裡看起來陰森森的。

ex.en: We told spooky stories around the campfire.
ex.zh: 我們圍著營火講了恐怖故事。

ex.en: She spoke softly so she wouldn't wake the baby.
ex.zh: 她輕聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

ex.en: The manager spoke to us about the new schedule yesterday.
ex.zh: 經理昨天跟我們談了新的時間表。

ex.en: One spoke on my bicycle wheel is broken.
ex.zh: 我腳踏車輪子上有一根輻條斷了。

ex.en: The wheel has thirty-two spokes, and each one must be tight.
ex.zh: 這個輪子有三十二根輻條，每一根都必須繃緊。

ex.en: The fireworks lit up the sky spectacularly.
ex.zh: 煙火壯觀地照亮了夜空。

ex.en: The plan failed spectacularly, and everyone laughed.
ex.zh: 這個計畫慘敗得很誇張，大家都笑了。

ex.en: The nurse speedily brought a glass of water.
ex.zh: 護理師很快就端來一杯水。

ex.en: Please reply as speedily as you can.
ex.zh: 請盡快回覆。

spent.zh: 花費（spend 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: I spent the whole weekend cleaning my room.
ex.zh: 我整個週末都在打掃房間。

ex.en: She has spent most of her savings on the trip.
ex.zh: 她把大部分積蓄都花在這趟旅行上。

ex.en: He lay down, completely spent after the marathon.
ex.zh: 跑完馬拉松後，他累得完全虛脫，躺了下來。

ex.en: The spent batteries should be thrown into the recycling bin.
ex.zh: 用完的電池應該丟進回收箱。

ex.en: She chose to spurn his offer of money.
ex.zh: 她選擇拒絕他提供的錢。

ex.en: Don't spurn advice from people who care about you.
ex.zh: 別輕視關心你的人所給的建議。

ex.en: A sparrow landed on the window and looked inside.
ex.zh: 一隻麻雀停在窗戶上往裡面看。

ex.en: Sparrows often gather near cafes to eat crumbs.
ex.zh: 麻雀常聚集在咖啡館附近啄食碎屑。

ex.en: The park is full of flowers in springtime.
ex.zh: 春天時公園裡開滿了花。

ex.en: Springtime is my favorite season of the year.
ex.zh: 春天是我一年中最喜歡的季節。

ex.en: The team played splendidly in the final.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中表現極佳。

ex.en: The hall was splendidly decorated for the wedding.
ex.zh: 大廳為婚禮布置得富麗堂皇。

ex.en: She wore a sporty jacket and white sneakers.
ex.zh: 她穿著運動風外套和白色球鞋。

ex.en: My brother is a sporty kid who plays every day.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是個愛運動的孩子，每天都會去運動。

ex.en: Some parents still spank their children, but many disagree.
ex.zh: 有些父母仍會打孩子屁股，但許多人不認同。

ex.en: The old woman threatened to spank the naughty boy.
ex.zh: 老太太威脅要打那個調皮男孩的屁股。

ex.en: In the old novel, she was called a spinster at thirty.
ex.zh: 在那部老小說裡，她三十歲就被稱為老處女。

ex.en: The word spinster is now considered old-fashioned.
ex.zh: spinster 這個字現在被視為過時的說法。

ex.en: The island is sparsely populated.
ex.zh: 這座島人煙稀少。

ex.en: The room was sparsely furnished with a bed and a desk.
ex.zh: 房間裡只擺了一張床和一張書桌，家具很少。

ex.en: Rain splattered against the window.
ex.zh: 雨水啪嗒啪嗒地濺在窗戶上。

ex.en: Don't splatter paint on the floor.
ex.zh: 不要把油漆濺到地板上。

ex.en: There was a splatter of mud on his jeans.
ex.zh: 他的牛仔褲上濺了一點泥巴。

ex.en: She wiped the grease splatter off the stove.
ex.zh: 她擦掉爐子上濺出的油漬。

ex.en: Water spurted out of the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 水從破裂的水管噴了出來。

ex.en: Blood spurted from the cut on his finger.
ex.zh: 血從他手指的傷口湧了出來。

ex.en: The runner put on a spurt of speed near the finish line.
ex.zh: 那位跑者在接近終點時突然加速衝刺。

ex.en: Plants often grow in sudden spurts in the spring.
ex.zh: 植物常在春天一陣一陣地快速生長。

ex.en: The children watched the top spinning on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子們看著陀螺在地板上旋轉。

ex.en: The washing machine is spinning too fast and shaking the floor.
ex.zh: 洗衣機轉得太快，把地板震得發抖。

ex.en: After the ride, my head was spinning and I had to sit down.
ex.zh: 坐完遊樂設施後，我頭暈目眩，只好坐下來。

ex.en: She felt the room spinning when she stood up too fast.
ex.zh: 她太快站起來時覺得房間在旋轉。

ex.en: Spinning wool into thread takes a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 把羊毛紡成線需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: My grandmother still remembers spinning cotton as a young girl.
ex.zh: 我奶奶還記得年輕時紡棉紗的情形。

ex.en: The Earth is not perfectly spherical, but nearly so.
ex.zh: 地球並非完美的球形，但相當接近。

ex.en: The lamp has a spherical glass shade.
ex.zh: 這盞燈有一個球形的玻璃燈罩。

ex.en: I love the spontaneity of traveling without a plan.
ex.zh: 我喜歡不做計畫旅行的隨興自在。

ex.en: His speech lacked spontaneity because he read every word.
ex.zh: 他一字不漏地照稿唸，演講缺乏自然的感覺。

ex.en: Add a spoonful of sugar to the tea.
ex.zh: 在茶裡加一匙糖。

ex.en: The baby ate only a spoonful of rice.
ex.zh: 寶寶只吃了一匙飯。

ex.en: He tightened the bolt with a spanner.
ex.zh: 他用扳手把螺栓鎖緊。

ex.en: Pass me the spanner from the toolbox, please.
ex.zh: 請把工具箱裡的扳手遞給我。

ex.en: The hotel room was small and spartan, with only a bed and a desk.
ex.zh: 那間旅館房間又小又簡樸，只有一張床和一張書桌。

ex.en: He lives a spartan life and spends very little money.
ex.zh: 他過著簡樸刻苦的生活，花費很少。

ex.en: Spartans were famous for their strict training.
ex.zh: 斯巴達人以嚴格的訓練聞名。

ex.en: She is a real spartan who never complains about hard work.
ex.zh: 她是個堅忍的人，從不抱怨辛苦的工作。

splutter.zh: 急促慌亂地說；發出噗噗聲

ex.en: He spluttered an apology when the water went up his nose.
ex.zh: 水嗆進鼻子時，他結結巴巴地道了歉。

ex.en: The old engine spluttered and then stopped.
ex.zh: 那台舊引擎噗噗響了幾聲就停了。

ex.en: The engine gave a splutter and died.
ex.zh: 引擎噗地響了一聲就熄火了。

ex.en: We heard a splutter from the old tap.
ex.zh: 我們聽到舊水龍頭傳來噗噗的噴水聲。

ex.en: The internship was a springboard for her career.
ex.zh: 這份實習是她職涯的跳板。

ex.en: The diver bounced on the springboard before jumping.
ex.zh: 跳水選手在跳板上彈了幾下才起跳。

ex.en: The cactus has long spiky leaves.
ex.zh: 這株仙人掌有長長的多刺葉片。

ex.en: He likes to wear his hair short and spiky.
ex.zh: 他喜歡把頭髮剪短並弄成刺蝟頭。

ex.en: Tea dripped from the spout of the old pot.
ex.zh: 茶從那把舊壺的壺嘴滴了出來。

ex.en: Water poured out of the spout and into the bucket.
ex.zh: 水從噴口流出，注入水桶裡。

ex.en: The whale spouted water high into the air.
ex.zh: 鯨魚把水噴向高空。

ex.en: Water spouted from the broken pipe.
ex.zh: 破裂的水管噴出水來。

ex.en: He likes to spout facts he read online.
ex.zh: 他喜歡滔滔不絕地講他在網路上讀到的事。

ex.en: Stop spouting nonsense and listen for a moment.
ex.zh: 別再胡扯了，聽我說一下。

ex.en: The soldiers divided the spoils of the battle among themselves.
ex.zh: 士兵們把戰利品在彼此之間分掉。

ex.en: The thieves hid the spoils in an old barn.
ex.zh: 小偷把贓物藏在一座舊穀倉裡。

ex.en: The bird laid speckled eggs in the nest.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥在巢裡下了有斑點的蛋。

ex.en: He wore a speckled gray sweater.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件帶有斑點的灰色毛衣。

ex.en: The spleen is an organ that helps filter the blood.
ex.zh: 脾臟是一個幫助過濾血液的器官。

ex.en: The doctor checked whether his spleen was damaged in the fall.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查他的脾臟是否在跌倒時受傷。

ex.en: He vented his spleen at the referee after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，他對裁判發洩滿腹怨氣。

ex.en: She spoke with spleen about the unfair rules.
ex.zh: 她憤憤不平地談起那些不公平的規定。

spotless.zh: 一塵不染的；無可挑剔的

ex.en: She keeps her kitchen spotless.
ex.zh: 她把廚房保持得一塵不染。

ex.en: He has a spotless record at work.
ex.zh: 他在工作上的紀錄無可挑剔。

ex.en: She put a new spool of thread on the sewing machine.
ex.zh: 她在縫紉機上裝了一個新的線軸。

ex.en: The fishing line came off the spool too quickly.
ex.zh: 釣魚線太快從捲軸上滑了出來。

ex.en: He spooled the cable around a wooden drum.
ex.zh: 他把電纜纏繞在木製捲筒上。

ex.en: The machine spools the film onto a reel.
ex.zh: 機器把底片捲到捲軸上。

ex.en: The sprinter crossed the finish line in first place.
ex.zh: 那位短跑選手第一個衝過終點線。

ex.en: A good sprinter needs strong legs and a quick start.
ex.zh: 優秀的短跑選手需要強壯的雙腿和迅速的起跑。

spying.zh: 當間諜；暗中監視（spy 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He was caught spying on his neighbors through the window.
ex.zh: 他被抓到從窗戶偷偷監視鄰居。

ex.en: The two countries accused each other of spying.
ex.zh: 兩國互相指控對方從事間諜活動。

ex.en: Spying is illegal in most countries.
ex.zh: 間諜活動在大多數國家都是違法的。

ex.en: The company fired him for industrial spying.
ex.zh: 公司因為他從事商業間諜行為而將他解僱。

ex.en: Her specialism is the history of Asian art.
ex.zh: 她的專長是亞洲藝術史。

ex.en: Doctors often choose a specialism after several years of training.
ex.zh: 醫生通常在受訓數年後選擇一個專科領域。

springfield.zh: 斯普林菲爾德（美國伊利諾州首府）

ex.en: Springfield is the capital of the state of Illinois.
ex.zh: 斯普林菲爾德是伊利諾州的州府。

ex.en: Many towns in the United States are named Springfield.
ex.zh: 美國有許多城鎮都叫斯普林菲爾德。

ex.en: The boy had a spotty face during his teenage years.
ex.zh: 那男孩青少年時期臉上長了很多斑點。

ex.en: The phone signal is spotty in the mountains.
ex.zh: 山區的手機訊號時有時無。

ex.en: The sportswriter wrote about last night's game.
ex.zh: 那位體育記者寫了昨晚比賽的報導。

ex.en: My uncle works as a sportswriter for a local paper.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在一家地方報社當體育記者。

ex.en: It rained sporadically throughout the day.
ex.zh: 一整天斷斷續續地下著雨。

ex.en: He only visits his old friends sporadically.
ex.zh: 他只是偶爾才去探望老朋友。

ex.en: The two boxers sparred for three rounds in the gym.
ex.zh: 兩位拳擊手在健身房對練了三回合。

ex.en: My brothers often spar over who gets to choose the movie.
ex.zh: 我的兄弟們常為了誰選電影而鬥嘴。

ex.en: The cat's toes splay when it lands on a slippery floor.
ex.zh: 貓在光滑的地板上落地時，腳趾會張開。

ex.en: He sat down and splayed his legs out in front of him.
ex.zh: 他坐下來，把雙腿向前張開。

splitting.zh: 分開；裂開（split 的現在分詞）

ex.en: They are splitting the bill equally among four people.
ex.zh: 他們四個人平均分攤帳單。

ex.en: The old log is splitting down the middle.
ex.zh: 那根舊木頭正從中間裂開。

ex.en: I woke up with a splitting headache this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上醒來頭痛欲裂。

ex.en: The loud noise gave her a splitting headache.
ex.zh: 吵雜的聲音讓她頭痛得厲害。

ex.en: The farmer is spraying the crops to protect them from insects.
ex.zh: 農夫正在對農作物噴藥，以防止蟲害。

ex.en: The kids were spraying each other with water in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們在院子裡互相噴水。

ex.en: The company offers spousal health insurance to its staff.
ex.zh: 公司為員工提供配偶健康保險。

ex.en: The court discussed spousal support after the divorce.
ex.zh: 法院討論了離婚後的配偶贍養費。

ex.en: Use salt sparingly when you cook.
ex.zh: 煮菜時鹽要少放一點。

ex.en: He praised people only sparingly.
ex.zh: 他很少稱讚別人。

ex.en: He got a ticket for speeding on the highway.
ex.zh: 他因為在高速公路上超速而被開罰單。

ex.en: Speeding is a major cause of traffic accidents.
ex.zh: 超速是交通事故的主要原因之一。

ex.en: The salmon are spawning in the upper river this month.
ex.zh: 這個月鮭魚正在河川上游產卵。

ex.en: Frogs are spawning in the pond by our house.
ex.zh: 青蛙正在我們家旁邊的池塘裡產卵。

ex.en: The popular show is spawning many copycats.
ex.zh: 這部熱門節目正衍生出許多模仿之作。

ex.en: Cheap loans are spawning a wave of new businesses.
ex.zh: 低利貸款正催生一波新創事業。

ex.en: Scientists use spectroscopy to find out what stars are made of.
ex.zh: 科學家用光譜學來找出恆星的組成。

ex.en: She took a course in spectroscopy at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學修了一門光譜學的課。

ex.en: Spectroscopy helps chemists identify unknown substances.
ex.zh: 光譜學幫助化學家辨識未知的物質。

ex.en: Sparta was a powerful city-state in ancient Greece.
ex.zh: 斯巴達是古希臘一個強大的城邦。

ex.en: Boys in Sparta began military training at a young age.
ex.zh: 斯巴達的男孩從很小就開始接受軍事訓練。

ex.en: A springbok leaped high over the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一隻跳羚高高躍過乾草叢。

ex.en: The springbok is a type of antelope found in southern Africa.
ex.zh: 跳羚是非洲南部的一種羚羊。

ex.en: She wound the thread around the spindle.
ex.zh: 她把線繞在紡錘上。

ex.en: The machine's spindle spins at high speed.
ex.zh: 這台機器的主軸高速旋轉。

ex.en: The young tree had spindly branches.
ex.zh: 那棵小樹的樹枝又細又長。

ex.en: A spindly old table stood in the corner.
ex.zh: 角落放著一張細腳的舊桌子。

sprained.zh: 扭傷（sprain 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: I sprained my ankle while playing basketball.
ex.zh: 我打籃球時扭傷了腳踝。

ex.en: She sprained her wrist when she fell.
ex.zh: 她跌倒時扭傷了手腕。

ex.en: I decided to splurge on a nice dinner.
ex.zh: 我決定奢侈一下，吃頓好的晚餐。

ex.en: They splurged on a trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 他們豁出去花錢去了趟日本。

ex.en: The new phone was a big splurge for me.
ex.zh: 這支新手機對我來說是一筆大花費。

ex.en: A weekend spa trip is a nice splurge.
ex.zh: 週末去做水療是一種不錯的犒賞花費。

ex.en: The speechwriter spent days polishing the address.
ex.zh: 這位講稿撰寫人花了好幾天修飾這篇演說。

ex.en: She works as a speechwriter for a mayor.
ex.zh: 她擔任一位市長的演講稿撰寫人。

ex.en: Oil began to spatter all over the stove.
ex.zh: 油開始濺得整個爐子都是。

ex.en: Rain spattered against the window.
ex.zh: 雨點啪啪地打在窗戶上。

ex.en: There was a spatter of mud on his white shirt.
ex.zh: 他的白襯衫上有幾點泥巴。

ex.en: A light spatter of rain fell on the road.
ex.zh: 路上落下了零星的雨點。

ex.en: He showed great sportsmanship by shaking hands with the winners.
ex.zh: 他和獲勝者握手，展現了高度的運動家精神。

ex.en: Good sportsmanship matters more than winning.
ex.zh: 良好的運動家風度比獲勝更重要。

ex.en: The scientist used a spectrometer to study the light from the star.
ex.zh: 科學家用光譜儀研究那顆恆星的光。

ex.en: A mass spectrometer can identify tiny amounts of chemicals.
ex.zh: 質譜儀能辨識微量的化學物質。

ex.en: The cake was soft and spongy, just as I like it.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕又軟又蓬鬆，正合我意。

ex.en: After the rain, the ground felt spongy under our boots.
ex.zh: 下過雨後，地面踩起來軟軟的，像海綿一樣。

ex.en: He is a big spender who loves buying gifts for friends.
ex.zh: 他花錢很大方，喜歡買禮物送朋友。

ex.en: As a careful spender, she always compares prices first.
ex.zh: 身為精打細算的人，她總是先比價。

ex.en: There was only a light sprinkling of snow on the ground.
ex.zh: 地上只有薄薄一層零星的雪。

ex.en: The salad had a sprinkling of nuts on top.
ex.zh: 沙拉上面撒了少許堅果。

ex.en: Prices are spiralling out of control.
ex.zh: 物價正急遽上漲、失去控制。

ex.en: The smoke was spiralling up into the sky.
ex.zh: 煙霧呈螺旋狀往天空升起。

ex.en: Our spaniel loves chasing balls in the park.
ex.zh: 我們家的西班牙獵犬喜歡在公園追球。

ex.en: The spaniel wagged its long ears and tail.
ex.zh: 那隻獵犬搖著長耳朵和尾巴。

ex.en: The children sat spellbound as she told the story.
ex.zh: 她講故事時，孩子們聽得入迷。

ex.en: The audience was spellbound by his performance.
ex.zh: 觀眾被他的演出迷住了。

ex.en: Workers cleaned up the oil spillage on the road.
ex.zh: 工人清理了路上漏出的油。

ex.en: Use a tray to prevent spillage.
ex.zh: 用托盤來避免溢灑。

ex.en: It was spiteful of him to tell everyone her secret.
ex.zh: 他把她的祕密告訴大家，實在太惡毒了。

ex.en: She made a spiteful comment about her sister's new haircut.
ex.zh: 她對妹妹的新髮型說了一句惡意的話。

ex.en: The baby spat out the carrots and laughed.
ex.zh: 寶寶把紅蘿蔔吐了出來，還咯咯笑。

ex.en: He spat on the ground and walked away angrily.
ex.zh: 他朝地上吐了口口水，憤怒地走開。

ex.en: The couple had a small spat over dinner.
ex.zh: 這對情侶晚餐時為了小事拌嘴。

ex.en: A silly spat between friends is usually forgotten the next day.
ex.zh: 朋友之間的無聊小爭執通常隔天就忘了。

ex.en: The sportscaster described the final minutes of the game.
ex.zh: 體育播報員描述了比賽最後幾分鐘的情況。

ex.en: My uncle works as a radio sportscaster.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是廣播電台的體育播報員。

ex.en: Turn the spigot slowly so the water doesn't splash everywhere.
ex.zh: 慢慢轉動水龍頭，水才不會到處濺。

ex.en: There is a spigot on the side of the house for watering the garden.
ex.zh: 房子側邊有個水龍頭可以澆花園。

ex.en: A spotter stood behind the weightlifter in case he dropped the bar.
ex.zh: 舉重選手身後站著一位保護員，以防槓鈴掉落。

ex.en: The bird club needs a spotter to watch for rare species.
ex.zh: 賞鳥社需要一位觀察員留意稀有鳥種。

ex.en: The mattress is soft but springy.
ex.zh: 這張床墊柔軟又有彈性。

ex.en: She walked with a springy step after the good news.
ex.zh: 聽到好消息後，她邁著輕快的步伐走路。

ex.en: She works at a store that sells sportswear.
ex.zh: 她在一家賣運動服裝的店工作。

ex.en: Comfortable sportswear is popular even outside the gym.
ex.zh: 舒適的運動服裝即使在健身房以外也很受歡迎。
